name: Machine Glute Kickback
steps: Face the glute machine and place your working foot against its footplate or the back of your leg against its roller.
Steady your torso on the machine’s supports and keep your standing knee slightly bent.
Drive your working leg smoothly backward and slightly upward by squeezing your glute until your hip reaches full extension.
Return your leg slowly forward with control, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Avoid arching your lower back to push the lever farther back; stop once your glute is fully contracted.
Push steadily through your heel and midfoot rather than swinging the pad rapidly.
